latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor for TikTok — initial release.

- Upload raw video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and describe your edit ("trim the clip, add trending captions, and sync cuts to the beat").
- Cloud rendering pipeline creates TikTok-optimized 1080p MP4 downloads after fast processing (30-90 seconds typical).
- Automatic setup with free anonymous token (100 credits, 7-day expiry); session managed transparently.
- One-step workflows: upload, instruct, and export without manual controls or complex UI.
- Prompts for upload, edit, export, credits, and timeline preview routed automatically; common errors handled clearly.
- All operations run securely via cloud with attribution headers for export.
